correctness.summary: Exact-CG orthogonality and A-conjugacy give an identity for each successive residual ratio. Kantorovich applied to A^{1/2}p_k yields the history-aware bound K^2/d_k-1, with d_k=1+beta_{k-1}d_{k-1}. The global factor (kappa-1)/(2 sqrt(kappa)) follows and is attained on every fixed SPD matrix at the first step by a residual supported on its extreme eigenspaces. Solving when the sharp factor is at most one gives kappa<=3+2 sqrt(2). Deterministic numerical checks reproduce the sharp examples and both inequalities.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Classical and modern sources establishing nonmonotone or prescribed CG residual behavior were checked, as were Meurant's stated residual-oscillation treatment and Brown's 2024 first-step vector criterion with a kappa>=7 sufficient example. Searches for the exact factor, threshold, synonymous monotonicity statements, and Kantorovich-based residual bounds did not locate the fixed-matrix if-and-only-if threshold, the sharp all-step factor, or the history refinement. Complete theorem-level text of the most relevant historical monograph treatments was not inspected, which remains the principal prior-coverage risk.

value.summary: The theorem gives an exact condition-number boundary for when Euclidean CG residual monitoring is guaranteed monotone for every right-hand side and initial guess, a sharp amplification factor above that boundary, a trackable history-based certificate, and a direct fixed-preconditioner interpretation.

limitations: Exact arithmetic and finite-dimensional real SPD matrices only.
No claim about floating-point recursively updated residuals or residual gaps.
The PCG extension concerns the M^{-1} residual norm, not the Euclidean residual norm.
The threshold is uniform over all right-hand sides and initial guesses; particular runs may be monotone above it.
No new A-norm error, iteration-complexity, or implementation-performance claim is made.
Complete theorem-level access to the most relevant historical monograph treatments was unavailable, leaving residual originality risk.
Independent audit has not been performed.
